sources.name: Fluent UI System Icons
sources.path: assets/*/metadata.json, asset file names (git tree), packages/svg-icons/package.json, LICENSE

provenance.notes: One entry per icon base name (a few asset folders hold more than one). Sizes and styles come from the asset file names in the git tree (ic_fluent_<name>_<size>_<style>.svg); tags are metadata.json metaphor plus keyword (minus the constant "fluent-icon"). 2654 of 2994 folders have a metadata.json. The model is recorded as "fill" from the published style names (regular/filled/light/color are all filled outlines); SVG files were not downloaded, so no grid attribute was tallied — sizes are the pixel sizes in the file names. Version is that of packages/svg-icons at the commit.

rtl.mechanism: metadata.json directionType: "mirror" (flip the asset) or "unique" (separately drawn LTR and RTL assets, named …_ltr / …_rtl); `singleton` names the default direction.
